The best saves from Week 4 of the 2026-27 NHL season are here, featuring a potential save of the year, incredible glove robberies and some clutch overtime stops.
Yaroslav Askarov makes a ridiculous diving glove save to rob Drake Batherson of a wide-open net, while Devin Cooley makes multiple appearances with spectacular stops including a sprawling save on Kirill Marchenko. Anthony Stolarz dives back for a desperation paddle save and Michal Postava delivers late in overtime during his first career NHL start.
Which save was the best of Week 4?
